text_en: A wise child loves discipline, but a scoffer does not listen to rebuke.
text_cn: 智慧之子，听从父亲的教训；轻狂的人，不听任何人规劝。

text_en: From the fruit of their words good persons eat good things, but the desire of the treacherous is for wrongdoing.
text_cn: 义人必饱尝自己口舌的果实，恶人的欲望只有饱食强暴。

text_en: Those who guard their mouths preserve their lives; those who open wide their lips come to ruin.
text_cn: 谨口慎言，方能自保性命；信口开河，终必自取灭亡。

text_en: The appetite of the lazy craves, and gets nothing, while the appetite of the diligent is richly supplied.
text_cn: 懒人虽常盼望，却一无所得；勤劳的人，却常如愿以偿。

text_en: The righteous hate falsehood, but the wicked act shamefully and disgracefully.
text_cn: 义人憎恶谎言，恶人令人可憎可恶。

text_en: Righteousness guards one whose way is upright, but sin overthrows the wicked.
text_cn: 正义保卫行为正直的人，邪恶却使罪人灭亡。

text_en: Some pretend to be rich, yet have nothing; others pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.
text_cn: 有人自充富人，其实一贫如洗；有人佯作穷人，其实腰缠万贯。

text_en: Wealth is a ransom for a person’s life, but the poor get no threats.
text_cn: 富人的钱财只是性命的赎价，穷人却没有这样的威胁。

text_en: The light of the righteous rejoices, but the lamp of the wicked goes out.
text_cn: 义人的光明，必要高升；恶人的灯火，势必熄灭。

text_en: By insolence the heedless make strife, but wisdom is with those who take advice.
text_cn: 傲慢只有引起争端，虚心受教的人才有智慧。

text_en: Wealth hastily gotten will dwindle, but those who gather little by little will increase it.
text_cn: 倘来之物，容易消逝；经久积存，日渐增多。

text_en: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but a desire fulfilled is a tree of life.
text_cn: 希望迟不兑现，令人心神烦恼；愿望获得满足，像株生命树。

text_en: Those who despise the word bring destruction on themselves, but those who respect the commandment will be rewarded.
text_cn: 谁轻视法令，必遭灭亡；谁敬畏诫命，必得安全。

text_en: The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life, so that one may avoid the snares of death.
text_cn: 智慧人的教训是生命的泉源，人可赖以脱免死亡的罗网。

text_en: Good sense wins favor, but the way of the faithless is their ruin.
text_cn: 明哲的规劝，使人蒙恩，残暴人的举止，粗鲁蛮横。

text_en: The clever do all things intelligently, but the fool displays folly.
text_cn: 精明的人，常按理智行事；愚昧的人，只自夸其糊涂。

text_en: A bad messenger brings trouble, but a faithful envoy, healing.
text_cn: 奸佞（nìng）的使者，使人陷于灾祸；忠诚的使者，给人带来安和。

text_en: Poverty and disgrace are for the one who ignores instruction, but one who heeds reproof is honored.
text_cn: 拒绝规劝的，必遭贫苦羞辱；接受惩戒的，反要受人尊敬。

text_en: A desire realized is sweet to the soul, but to turn away from evil is an abomination to fools.
text_cn: 愿望获得满足，能使心灵愉快；远离邪恶，却为愚昧人所深恶。

text_en: Whoever walks with the wise becomes wise, but the companion of fools suffers harm.
text_cn: 与智慧人往来，可成智慧人；与愚昧人作伴，必受其连累。

text_en: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.
text_cn: 恶运追踪罪人，义人却得善报。

text_en: The good leave an inheritance to their children’s children, but the sinner’s wealth is laid up for the righteous.
text_cn: 善人为子子孙孙留下产业，罪人的财富是为义人积蓄。

text_en: The field of the poor may yield much food, but it is swept away through injustice.
text_cn: 穷人开垦的田地，生产大量食物；谁若缺乏正义，定不免于灭亡。

text_en: Those who spare the rod hate their children, but those who love them are diligent to discipline them.
text_cn: 不肯使用棍杖的人，实是恨自己的儿子，真爱儿子的人，必时加以惩罚。

text_en: The righteous have enough to satisfy their appetite, but the belly of the wicked is empty.
text_cn: 义人必得饱食，恶人无以果腹。
